ruledOut: Keep a full CLAUDE.md copy from embed

label: The install's link shape creates a CLAUDE.md symlink while the embed shape removes a project CLAUDE.md, so the two choices leave Claude Code with opposite instruction-file states.

The agents-md check names a claude-only state for CLAUDE.md without AGENTS.md but has no state for the reverse, and A10 accepts an absent CLAUDE.md, so an embed install passes with no Claude instruction file.

The install's final /doctor:setup runs six component legs and none reports brief delivery or hook approval; the Codex approval check runs only under /doctor:runtime-mirrors and hook wiring only under /doctor:symlink check.

The measured after arm lands on those shapes: Codex delivered 0 of 24 briefs and Claude 0 of 24 Gate 2 bullets, so two of six runtimes finish a successful install with either no brief or no policy definition.
A one-line @AGENTS.md pointer satisfies both readings of Claude instruction loading, costs 12 bytes, cannot double-load, and the manifest already lists pointer as an expected CLAUDE.md state.
The install guide never says that embed removes CLAUDE.md or that Claude depends on it, so the person cannot see the runtime-specific cost of the choice.
Both repairs are display and file-authoring only: one pointer at embed time, one check row, and one setup line that calls the two existing read-only checks.
